## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtra by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the meditative state of *gathering many virtues equally* (*děng jí zhòng dé* 等集眾德 — the *Sarvapuṇya-samuccaya-samādhi*).

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266–313 CE). The work is paralleled by [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's *Jí yī qiè fú dé sānmèi jīng* 集一切福德三昧經 ([KR6g0028](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0028), T0382).
